# COR041 `missing-intrinsic`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

An intrinsic module is used without the `intrinsic` keyword.

## Why

`use iso_fortran_env` picks up a user module of the same name if one is on the module path.
`use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env` always gets the compiler's module.

## Reported

```fortran
use iso_fortran_env, only: real64
```

## Preferred

```fortran
use, intrinsic :: iso_fortran_env, only: real64
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[COR041] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = COR041` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `C122` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
